name: CarCrafters
description: CarCrafters is a modern, premium car dealership and rental platform built with cutting-edge web technologies. The platform offers an immersive browsing experience with stunning animations, interactive 3D car previews, and a fully responsive design optimized for all devices.

paragraphs: CarCrafters is a modern, premium car dealership and rental platform built with cutting-edge web technologies. The platform offers an immersive browsing experience with stunning animations, interactive 3D car previews, and a fully responsive design optimized for all devices.
Whether you're looking to buy your dream car or rent a luxury vehicle, CarCrafters provides a seamless, visually engaging experience that sets it apart from traditional automotive websites.
features: Smooth, scroll-triggered animations powered by framer-motion and ScrollTrigger for a premium user experience
Sleek dark theme with glassmorphism effects and vibrant blue accents
Optimized for all devices - desktop, tablet, and mobile
SPA-style navigation without page reloads for instant transitions
Explore cars in immersive 3D with Three.js-powered interactive models
